say:0:1620887001:1.text: A roll of 16 or above is required to use the "Sense" skill. But...
say:0:1620887001:1.source_cn: 使用技能“洞悉”，需要掷出16点，方可判断为行动成功。

narration:3:1620887003:1.text: You are unable to roll the dice.
narration:3:1620887003:1.male: You are unable to roll the dice.
narration:3:1620887003:1.female: You are unable to roll the dice.

narration:4:1620887004:0.text: With the President in possession of the die, your fate is set in stone, and you are unable to act as you wish.
narration:4:1620887004:0.source_cn: 变数已经被吞噬。必然的命运已经锚定了你的未来，你无权自由行动
narration:4:1620887004:0.male: With the President in possession of the die, your fate is set in stone, and you are unable to act as you wish.
narration:4:1620887004:0.female: With the President in possession of the die, your fate is set in stone, and you are unable to act as you wish.

say:5:1620887005:1.text: There is only one path you may take.
say:5:1620887005:1.source_cn: 依照注定的命运所示……行动判定成功。

say:6:1620887006:1.text: A chaotic, blazing trail emerges on the ground.
say:6:1620887006:1.source_cn: 一段凌乱的痕迹从地面上浮现，在你的视野中灼灼燃烧。
say:6:1620887006:1.male: A chaotic, blazing trail emerges on the ground.
say:6:1620887006:1.female: A chaotic, blazing trail emerges on the ground.

say:7:1620887007:1.text: The flames point toward the <style="highlight">northwest</style>, marking the path the Hypogean took in its escape.
